ov: The familiar city pigeon is the domestic form of the wild rock dove, native to southern Europe, North Africa and western Asia. Escaped domestic birds are the origin of feral pigeons worldwide.

why.dm: The wild rock dove isn’t domesticated, but domestic pigeons, with about 1,000 breeds, descend from it.
why.et: Hunted and eaten as a game bird in many countries.

rg: Wild rock doves: southern Europe, North Africa and western Asia. Domestic and feral pigeons: worldwide, up to 120 million birds.
